name: disk_automount
description: Mounts an internal or secondary disk by UUID at boot and makes it available to the MPD library.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: Keeps Volumio on a flash drive or SD card and your music on a separate internal/SATA/NVMe disk. Select the disk by UUID; it is mounted at boot by a small systemd service (no sudo rules, no fstab edits) and linked into the MPD library. Reinstalling Volumio never touches the music disk.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.0 - first release: root work is done by a systemd service started from a settings file, the plugin itself runs unprivileged
